```{r setup, include=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(vegan)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(multcomp)
library(agricolae)
library(gridExtra)
library(here)

run_name   <- params$run_name
output_dir <- params$output_dir
group_var  <- params$group_var
prefix     <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

custom_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## 1. Load Data

```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Species count table (rows: species, columns: samples)
otu_raw <- read_excel(here("data", "species_abundance.xlsx"), sheet = "species_counts_transposed")
otu_table <- as.data.frame(otu_raw)
rownames(otu_table) <- otu_table[, 1]
otu_table <- otu_table[, -1]

# Transpose if needed: rows = samples, columns = species
# otu_table <- t(otu_table)

# Metadata
metadata <- read_excel(here("data", "metadata.xlsx"), sheet = "metadata")
metadata <- as.data.frame(metadata)

# Align samples
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(otu_table), metadata$SampleID)
cat("OTU table samples:", nrow(otu_table), "\n")
cat("Metadata samples:", nrow(metadata), "\n")
cat("Common samples:", length(common_samples), "\n\n")

otu_table <- otu_table[common_samples, ]
metadata  <- metadata[match(common_samples, metadata$SampleID), ]

cat("OTU table dimensions:", dim(otu_table), "\n")
cat("Metadata dimensions:", dim(metadata), "\n")
```

## 2. Compute Alpha Diversity Indices

```{r compute-indices}
observed   <- rowSums(otu_table > 0)
shannon    <- diversity(otu_table, index = "shannon")
evenness   <- shannon / log(observed)
chao1      <- apply(otu_table, 1, function(x) estimateR(x)["S.chao1"])

alpha_df <- data.frame(
  SampleID   = rownames(otu_table),
  Observed   = observed,
  Shannon    = shannon,
  Evenness   = evenness,
  Chao1      = chao1
)
alpha_df <- merge(alpha_df, metadata, by = "SampleID")

# Summary statistics helper
summary_funcs <- list(
  Mean     = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
  SD       = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
  SE       = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.))),
  CI_Lower = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE) - qt(0.975, sum(!is.na(.)) - 1) *
               (sd(., na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.)))),
  CI_Upper = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE) + qt(0.975, sum(!is.na(.)) - 1) *
               (sd(., na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.)))),
  Median   = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE),
  Min      = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
  Max      = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
)

metrics <- c("Observed", "Shannon", "Evenness", "Chao1")

summary_group <- alpha_df %>%
  group_by(!!sym(group_var)) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            across(all_of(metrics), summary_funcs, .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop")

summary_total <- alpha_df %>%
  summarise(!!sym(group_var) := "Total",
            n = n(),
            across(all_of(metrics), summary_funcs, .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"))

final_summary <- bind_rows(summary_group, summary_total)

# Export
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Individual_Samples")
writeData(wb, "Individual_Samples", alpha_df)
addWorksheet(wb, "Summary_Statistics")
writeData(wb, "Summary_Statistics", final_summary)
saveWorkbook(wb,
             file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "alpha_diversity_indices.xlsx")),
             overwrite = TRUE)

knitr::kable(head(alpha_df), caption = "Alpha Diversity Indices (first 6 rows)")
```

## 3. Statistical Testing

```{r statistical-tests, warning=FALSE}
perform_statistical_tests <- function(df, metric, group_var) {

  formula_str <- as.formula(paste(metric, "~", group_var))
  groups      <- unique(df[[group_var]])
  n_groups    <- length(groups)

  cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n")
  cat("METRIC:", metric, "\n")
  cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

  # Normality (Shapiro-Wilk)
  normality <- df %>%
    group_by(!!sym(group_var)) %>%
    summarise(n       = n(),
              W       = shapiro.test(.data[[metric]])$statistic,
              p_value = shapiro.test(.data[[metric]])$p.value,
              Normal  = ifelse(p_value > 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
              .groups = "drop")
  print(knitr::kable(normality, digits = 4, caption = "Shapiro-Wilk normality test"))
  all_normal <- all(normality$p_value > 0.05)

  # Homogeneity of variance (Levene)
  homogeneous <- TRUE
  if (n_groups >= 2) {
    levene      <- df %>% levene_test(formula_str)
    homogeneous <- levene$p > 0.05
    cat("Levene's test: F =", round(levene$statistic, 4),
        ", p =", round(levene$p, 4),
        ifelse(homogeneous, " (homogeneous)\n", " (heterogeneous)\n"))
  }

  # Select test
  result <- list()

  if (n_groups == 2) {
    if (all_normal && homogeneous) {
      test <- t.test(formula_str, data = df, var.equal = TRUE)
      result <- list(method = "Independent t-test", test_type = "parametric",
                     statistic = test$statistic, p_value = test$p.value)
    } else {
      test <- wilcox.test(formula_str, data = df)
      result <- list(method = "Wilcoxon rank-sum test", test_type = "non-parametric",
                     statistic = test$statistic, p_value = test$p.value)
    }
    result$post_hoc <- NULL

  } else {
    if (all_normal && homogeneous) {
      aov_fit <- aov(formula_str, data = df)
      aov_sum <- summary(aov_fit)
      result  <- list(method = "One-way ANOVA", test_type = "parametric",
                      statistic = aov_sum[[1]]$`F value`[1],
                      p_value   = aov_sum[[1]]$`Pr(>F)`[1])
      if (result$p_value < 0.05) {
        tukey  <- TukeyHSD(aov_fit)
        hsd    <- HSD.test(aov_fit, group_var)
        result$post_hoc        <- hsd$groups
        result$post_hoc_method <- "Tukey HSD"
      }
    } else {
      kw <- kruskal.test(formula_str, data = df)
      result <- list(method = "Kruskal-Wallis test", test_type = "non-parametric",
                     statistic = kw$statistic, p_value = kw$p.value)
      if (result$p_value < 0.05) {
        ph <- df %>% pairwise_wilcox_test(formula_str, p.adjust.method = "BH")
        result$post_hoc        <- ph
        result$post_hoc_method <- "Pairwise Wilcoxon (BH correction)"
      }
    }
  }

  result$significant        <- result$p_value < 0.05
  result$significance_level <- ifelse(result$p_value < 0.001, "***",
                               ifelse(result$p_value < 0.01,  "**",
                               ifelse(result$p_value < 0.05,  "*", "ns")))

  cat("Result:", ifelse(result$significant, "SIGNIFICANT", "not significant"),
      " | p =", round(result$p_value, 4),
      result$significance_level, "\n")

  return(result)
}

all_test_results <- lapply(setNames(metrics, metrics),
                           perform_statistical_tests,
                           df = alpha_df, group_var = group_var)
```

## 4. Summary of Statistical Tests

```{r summary-table}
stat_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(metrics, function(m) {
  r <- all_test_results[[m]]
  data.frame(
    Metric      = m,
    Test_Method = r$method,
    Test_Type   = r$test_type,
    Statistic   = round(r$statistic, 4),
    P_value     = round(r$p_value, 4),
    Significance = r$significance_level,
    Post_hoc    = ifelse(is.null(r$post_hoc), "None", r$post_hoc_method),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

write.xlsx(stat_summary,
           file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "alpha_diversity_stats_summary.xlsx")),
           rowNames = FALSE)

knitr::kable(stat_summary, caption = "Statistical Test Summary")
```

## 5. Boxplots with Statistical Annotations

```{r boxplots, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, warning=FALSE}
plot_alpha <- function(df, metric, group_var) {
  r <- all_test_results[[metric]]

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[group_var]], y = .data[[metric]],
                      fill = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    custom_theme +
    labs(title = paste("Alpha Diversity —", metric),
         x = group_var, y = metric) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    stat_compare_means(
      method     = ifelse(r$test_type == "parametric", "anova", "kruskal.test"),
      label      = "p.format",
      label.x.npc = 0.95,
      label.y.npc = 0.95,
      hjust = 1, size = 5
    )

  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "alpha_", metric, "_boxplot.png")),
         p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  return(p)
}

plot_list <- lapply(metrics, plot_alpha, df = alpha_df, group_var = group_var)
for (p in plot_list) print(p)
```

## 6. Combined Plot

```{r combined-plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
combined <- grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 3)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "alpha_diversity_combined.png")),
       combined, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

## 7. Rarefaction Curves

```{r rarefaction, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
otu_matrix <- round(as.matrix(otu_table))

color_mapping  <- setNames(rainbow(length(unique(alpha_df[[group_var]]))),
                           unique(alpha_df[[group_var]]))
sample_colors  <- color_mapping[alpha_df[[group_var]][
                    match(rownames(otu_matrix), alpha_df$SampleID)]]

rarecurve(otu_matrix, step = 50,
          sample = min(rowSums(otu_matrix)),
          col = sample_colors, label = FALSE,
          xlab = "Sequencing Depth", ylab = "Number of Species",
          main = "Rarefaction Curves")
legend("bottomright", legend = names(color_mapping),
       col = color_mapping, lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 0.8)

png(file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "rarefaction_curves.png")),
    width = 1000, height = 700, res = 120)
rarecurve(otu_matrix, step = 50,
          sample = min(rowSums(otu_matrix)),
          col = sample_colors, label = FALSE,
          xlab = "Sequencing Depth", ylab = "Number of Species",
          main = "Rarefaction Curves")
legend("bottomright", legend = names(color_mapping),
       col = color_mapping, lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 0.8)
dev.off()
```

## 8. Post-hoc Results

```{r posthoc-details}
posthoc_list <- list()

for (metric in metrics) {
  r <- all_test_results[[metric]]
  if (!is.null(r$post_hoc) && r$significant) {
    cat("\n###", metric, "— Post-hoc:", r$post_hoc_method, "\n")
    print(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(r$post_hoc), digits = 4))
    posthoc_list[[metric]] <- as.data.frame(r$post_hoc)
  }
}

if (length(posthoc_list) > 0) {
  write.xlsx(posthoc_list,
             file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "alpha_diversity_posthoc.xlsx")))
}
```
